title: Find the Middle of a Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, return the value of the middle node. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` node values.

sample_tests.explanation: Two middle nodes 3 and 4, return second (4).

hints: Use fast and slow pointers: slow advances 1 step, fast advances 2 steps.
When fast reaches the end, slow will be precisely at the middle.
For even lengths, slow naturally lands on the second middle node.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = data[1:1+n]
    print(vals[n // 2])
